Name: Secret Gourmet
Author: undare
Description:
[b][size=5][color=#fff2cc]Secret Gourmet[/color]![/size]



[size=5][color=#6aa84f]About [/color]:[/size]
[size=4]-You can explore the new cave on the desert, filled with research notes and special machines. (and rewards)[/size]
[b]-The  mod offers many new farming/crafting phases balanced for a "mid" to "endgame" content.
-It plans to offer a competitive option between "[color=#b6d7a8]Farming [/color]and [color=#e69138]Mining[/color]".
[/b]
[size=4]-This mod takes advantage of the [/size][color=#a4c2f4]Hybrid Crop mod[/color][size=4] (from Spacechase0) for a special way to create crops.[/size]
[size=4]-The events and notes on the map will guide you on how to make the best of it!.[/size]


[size=5][color=#ffe599]Suggestions [/color]:[/size]
[size=4]It is suggested to use with these mods :  (Optional)[/size]

[size=4]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4986]Animated Gemstones[/url] (Highly recomended)
[b]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] [b][size=4](Highly recomended)[/size][/b][/b][/size]
[size=4]- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5678]Mineral Mage[/url]﻿ (Recomended)
[/size]



[size=5][color=#6d9eeb]Installation[/color]:
[/size][size=4]Get the Required files above.
Unpack this file inside your Stardew/mods folder[/size]



[size=5][color=#e69138]Content[/color]:
[/size][size=4]You can find the cave up nort on the [color=#fff2cc]desert[/color]. 
You may need more than simple gold as currency to start this new farming experience. (As some dispensers require specific [color=#ffd966]materials [/color]as currency)

The value of the items and the time it takes to make them, was based on the 3 biggest profiting paths on the current SDV version.
They wont overshadow those, but still, will offer a bit extra if you get the best of them.

The mod also add some rewards.
Some of them are weapons balanced around the final weapons of the game.
Just 10% roughly better, as they take some good effort to get them.
[/size]


[size=5][color=#c27ba0]Config[/color]:[/size]
[size=4]There are 2 options to turn animations on/off[/size]
[size=4]with true or false.[/size]

[size=5][color=#8e7cc3]Notes [/color]:
[/size][size=4]Tested and optimized for Automate + Pfm
Conflicts with Quality Seeds mod.[/size]
[/b]
